verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a clear self-serve merchant path: onboard as a seller in the Dashboard, publish a CSV product feed via API, and review/accept per-agent terms, with orders flowing through standard Stripe rails and Dashboard attribution. However, ACS/full checkout is explicitly gated as 'private preview' and limited to US/Canada/select European countries, and the custom (ACP-style) integration requires a waitlist rather than being fully open self-serve. Missing for 10: general availability outside private preview, no waitlist/approval gate for full onboarding, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that the self-serve flow works end-to-end in production.
